engine.rng_contract: Do not wrap or modify engine/RNG. End-of-day weed generation consumes one shared RNG before shop unlock; different planting can change later shop order. Comparisons remain same-seed and same-seat, both seats, with empirical paired differences clustered by seed.

inputs.public_guard_definition: Existing SEARCH-LOOP section 4 implementation: eligible calibration public pool, ranked by maximum lineage votes across 20260922-20260925 descending, then sha256 descending; first 15.

H2.change: decrement the first step-0 SELL order by one unit; after parent step-1 processing, detect rival_money = own_money + forfeited step-0 quote within 0.5 and set _RACE_STATE[player].level = 24
H2.activation: step-0 decrement for every opponent; mirror mode only on adjusted cash detection

H3.activation: clone detection followed by race-lost escalation only

H4.change: on mirror detection at step 717 replace market orders using the parent's terminal liquidation rule over projected shed; parent step-718 behavior remains

telemetry.smoke: Before the remainder of Stage 1, run parent and every arm against O at seed 5000 in both seats. These 12 games are included in Stage 1 and are not extra samples.
telemetry.smoke_pass: No candidate-side invalid or wrapper error; each arm-specific mutation counter is positive across its two games. H2 additionally requires absolute first-turn cash difference >= 1 in each game. Parent requires two valid games and exposed race telemetry.

validity.invalid: candidate/parent-side exception, candidate/parent-side caught error counter, candidate/parent-side timeout, steps != 720, or either final status != DONE
validity.opponent_caught_errors: record separately; do not invalidate and do not exclude from adjudication
validity.runtime: candidate/parent-side calls only; across every card game max step < 0.5 seconds and empirical p99 over all calls < 0.10 seconds; zero candidate/parent exceptions
validity.timeout_detection: worker subprocess timeout or engine non-DONE status; either is invalid

statistics.score: win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0 from our seat
statistics.paired_unit: For parent-vs-arm comparisons, average both seats within each seed, then compute empirical paired differences across seeds.
statistics.paired_se: sample standard deviation of seed-level paired differences divided by sqrt(number of seeds); no fixed-environment variance formula
statistics.paired_lower95: mean paired difference minus t_(0.975, n-1) times paired SE
statistics.wilson_primary: 99% Wilson lower bound with z=2.576 over game scores, treating a draw as half success via effective successes wins + 0.5*draws, as required by the card's 5-arm correction

stage1.arm_pass: score rate >= 0.60; only passing arms enter Stage 2
stage1.no_passing_arms: FAIL and no Stage 2. The card's narrower all-arms-below-0.55 statement is recorded but does not relax the explicit >=0.60 advancement threshold.

public_guard.pass: zero files with arm score rate more than 0.10 below parent

hosted_panel.source: P4 source A closed-loop hosted seed and seat
hosted_panel.pass: mean paired delta-margin 95% lower bound > -(parent mean absolute margin * 0.05)

activation.nonclone_scope: DP plus the 15 guard files, excluding any opponent whose sha256 equals O

stage2.runtime: all card games satisfy frozen runtime validity

stage3.condition: If at least two arms pass every Stage 2 criterion, create exactly one low-interference combination and rerun the full Stage 2 criteria on seeds 5400-5599 as specified by the card.
stage3.stop_if_choice_not_determined: If more than one low-interference combination is possible and the card does not determine which one, STOP and report before creating or running a combination.

final_confirmation.selection: highest Stage 2 primary lower bound; tie-break by larger DP noninferiority delta
final_confirmation.winner_curse_warning: point estimate more than 0.05 below Stage 2 point estimate; warning only, verdict unchanged

forbidden: post-result threshold, seed, or sample changes
